about: Corrections to PYQ question text in lib/pyqData.ts, applied by scripts/pyq/fixQuestions.mts and by regenerate.mts. The original generator OCR'd the PYQ book and left debris in the text: the next heading glued onto the end, margin digits and stray letters inside sentences, and spaces inside hyphenated words. Every entry was checked against the book's own text layer. 'from' must match the current text exactly, so an entry cannot touch a question that has since changed.
